# trajectory of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:trajectoryOf`](gmeow-trajectoryOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/trajectoryOf>

- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The entity whose space-time path this trajectory describes. Functional: a trajectory belongs to exactly one entity.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Trajectory`](../classes/gmeow-Trajectory.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md); functional

Use [`gmeow:trajectoryOf`](gmeow-trajectoryOf.md) from [`gmeow:Trajectory`](../classes/gmeow-Trajectory.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single entity whose path a trajectory describes; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid sharing one [`Trajectory`](../classes/gmeow-Trajectory.md) across entities (mint one per entity).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:trajectoryOf`](gmeow-trajectoryOf.md) per [`Trajectory`](../classes/gmeow-Trajectory.md).
